record.paper_title: Some open problems on well-filtered spaces and sober spaces
record.context_brief: Regular opens of the real line
record.original_question: Let B be the complete Boolean algebra of all regular open subsets U of the real line, ordered by inclusion, where regular open means U equals the interior of the closure of U. Is the Scott space Sigma B=(B, sigma(B)) sober?

evidence.quote: Question 3.6. ([15]) Let B be the complete Boolean algebra of all regular open subsets of the reals line. Is the Scott space ΣB sober?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $B$ denote the collection of all regular open subsets of the real line $\mathbb{R}$ with its usual topology, where a set $U \subseteq \mathbb{R}$ is regular open if $U = \mathrm{int}(\overline{U})$. Ordered by set-inclusion, $B$ is a complete Boolean algebra. The Scott topology $\sigma(B)$ on $B$ consists of those subsets $V \subseteq B$ such that (i) $V$ is an upper set (if $x \in V$ and $x \le y$ then $y \in V$), and (ii) for every directed subset $D \subseteq B$ with $\sup D \in V$, one has $D \cap V \neq \emptyset$. Write $\Sigma B = (B, \sigma(B))$ for the associated Scott space. A topological space $X$ is sober if every nonempty irreducible closed subset of $X$ (i.e., a closed set $C$ that cannot be written as the union of two proper closed subsets) is the closure of a unique point of $X$.

Question: Is the Scott space $\Sigma B$ sober?
artifact.status_search_result: The question of whether the Scott space of the complete Boolean algebra of regular open subsets of the real line is sober is listed as an open problem in the literature on well-filtered and sober spaces. Recent work (e.g., a 2025 preprint on sobriety conditions for Scott topologies of open-set lattices) continues to investigate related sufficient conditions but does not resolve this specific question, suggesting it remains open.

status_evidence.title: Some open problems on well-filtered spaces and sober spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Lists open problems concerning sobriety of Scott spaces, including the case of the complete Boolean algebra of regular open subsets of the reals.

status_evidence.title: When do weakly first-countable spaces and the Scott topology of open set lattice become sober?
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work providing sufficient conditions for sobriety of Scott topologies of open set lattices, without resolving the specific question for the regular-open Boolean algebra of the reals.
status_evidence.claim: Specific question for B(R) not resolved in recent work.
